label: Öffentliche Seiten (Org-Website, Tickets, Shop, Formulare, Mitgliederbereich)
surface: Public: served at <org>.<root domain>, at the org's own domain (src/proxy.ts maps the host via site_for_host()), or at /s/<org> on the roots address. Routes below are written relative to the org site (the /s/[site] prefix is stripped on subdomains/own domains). Reads use createPublicClient() (anon) + getSite(slug) / the cached loaders in src/lib/public-cache.ts; writes only through public Server Actions that validate input + link tokens.
language: UI language: the org's language (Website › Marke, theme.locale) via x-roots-site, else the visitor's locale cookie / browser. All buyer-facing texts use 'du'.

frame.name: SiteFrame
frame.summary: Wraps every public page of an org (live version of org_sites only, via cachedSite()). No roots chrome: no nav bar, no logo bar, no cart icon, no language switch of its own.
frame.metadata: generateMetadata: tab title template '%s · <Org>', default '<Org>'; description = site tagline; favicon/apple icon + OG/Twitter image = org logo (imageUrlOn on the org's own domain). Pages add their own title (event: title + date/venue + event picture; product: name + picture; form: title + intro).

parts.name: Theme
parts.shows: div.site-theme (min-h-svh), .dark when theme.mode = dark; org fonts as a Google Fonts <link> (fontsHref); <style> with token overrides from themeCss(theme) + the org's own CSS (cleanCss).

parts.name: Header
parts.shows: Org's own header HTML (Website › Seiten › Rahmen, header_html), cleaned with cleanHtml(), in div.site-header. Absent when the org set none.

parts.name: Page content
parts.shows: children (each page brings its own main column, mostly max-w-xl/2xl, centred).

parts.name: Footer
parts.shows: Org's own footer HTML (footer_html, cleanHtml) in div.site-footer, then a small muted footer row with 'Impressum' (site.imprint → /impressum) and 'Datenschutz' (site.privacy → /datenschutz), each only when the org filled that text.

frame.phone: Same on every device; pages are single columns that stack (max-w-* + px-4).
uxNotes: Without own header HTML there is no persistent navigation on any public page: the shop, cart, member area and start page are only reachable through back links inside each page.
Impressum/Datenschutz links disappear entirely when the texts are empty (pages 404), nothing tells the org this on the public side.
No not-found.tsx and no loading.tsx under src/app/s: unknown orgs/events/products fall back to the global 404, and navigation has no skeleton.

routeHandlers.purpose: Shop order invoice PDF (not for drafts).
Product download for paid buyers (signed URL).
Music downloads (album ZIP or single track) from R2.
302 to a short-lived 128k stream MP3 for the player (only tracks marked stream).
Rental documents shared with the main tenant (portal session).
Files embedded in released wiki pages.

Wir melden uns per E-Mail, sobald ein Platz frei wird.' or ?error= (invalid email, name missing, too many, 'Du stehst schon auf der Warteliste.', 'Es gibt wieder freie Plätze – du kannst direkt buchen.'). Back link label 'Alle Events' (site.back) leads to the start page, which may not list events at all (blocks/HTML mode).
Description is plain text (whitespace-pre-line), while products and forms on the same site show rich text / Markdown.

Free (total 0): order marked paid at once, tickets issued, redirect to /t/<order>?k=<token>&paid=1. Tickets mail ('ticket' event mail with PDF attachment and the /t link) goes out on fulfilment. Errors → back to this page with ?error= (sold out 'Leider ausverkauft – jemand war schneller.', 'Der Preis hat sich gerade geändert …', not on sale, invalid email, name missing, holder missing, too many; setup problems → 'Der Ticketverkauf ist gerade nicht möglich …' shop.unavailable).

Pay button says '{amount} bezahlen'; the shop's checkout button says 'Zahlungspflichtig bestellen · {amount}' – two wordings for the same step, and the ticket checkout has no AGB/Widerruf checkbox while the shop's has.
The service fee appears for the first time on this step (not on the event page).
Name/email are plain Inputs (not TypedInput kind=email), unlike the App.

Delivery/rate choice is a page reload (links) – anything already typed into the order form below is lost when the buyer changes delivery afterwards.
The order form disappears completely while any line has a problem; only the red line text explains why.
'Warenkorb wiederherstellen' only appears when the cart is empty; with a non-empty cart a cancelled payment shows nothing.

pages.phone: The bottom tab bar is the phone pattern (app-like); 'Karte' opens alone so the card can be shown at the door. Content gets pb-24 for the bar.
uxNotes: The 'Infos' tab is shown to every signed-in person when the wiki module is on (no show() check), but its section renders nothing for non-members or when no pages are released – an empty tab.
Only members can edit their data: 'Meine Daten' lives in the members section, so tenants, course participants and ticket buyers can't change phone/address; nobody can change their email.
After 'Link zuschicken' the page only shows the sent text – no 'resend' or 'use another address' link, and no hint to check spam.
The whole area is called 'Mitgliederbereich' even for tenants or ticket buyers without a membership; the mail-failed text says 'melde dich beim Verein' regardless of the org type.

The membership facts are a hand-made <dl>, the rental facts too (app.md asks for DetailList); the rental row label 'Kündigungsfrist (Monate)' is the App's form label and repeats 'Monate' in the value.
The current IBAN is not prefilled and changing it is labelled 'Bankverbindung ändern' but the button says 'Neues Mandat erteilen' – two names for one step.
Status 'Ausgetreten' (membership.state.ended) is the App's wording, shown to the member.
The login link mail is built in the visitor's language (getT) with a hard-coded green button, not the org's language/brand or its email template.

uxNotes: Two string namespaces talk to the same buyer: tickets use shop.* ('Tickets', '{amount} bezahlen'), the merch shop uses store.* ('Shop', 'Zahlungspflichtig bestellen · {amount}'); the two checkouts differ in fields (shop: phone + address required; tickets: name + email only), legal checkboxes, and error handling.
Errors on public forms are toasts (Notice) except /f forms (inline alert); the event page has no Notice at all.
All buyer-facing texts use 'du' consistently; success texts use exclamation marks ('Zahlung erfolgreich!', 'Danke für deine Bestellung!', 'Danke! …').
Inputs on public pages are plain shadcn Inputs/native selects; TypedInput (iban, phone, postcode) only appears in the portal's data/bank forms.
